dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Concave spline fitted to the trailing edge, exhibiting significant posterior curvature from the dorsal ridge to the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Acute shape classification with a small pixel radius, creating a sharply defined morphological point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Moderate positive slope of approximately 40 degrees relative to the longitudinal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximate 0.8:1 ratio of maximum vertical pixel height to maximum longitudinal base width.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Large, smooth radius forming a bulbous convex curve across the anterior-dorsal boundary.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short pixel length with a thick base, exhibiting low protrusion from the primary cranial mass.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Highly obtuse interior angle at the transition point between the melon slope and the rostrum.

other_distinctive_markers: Uniform teal-cyan translucency with internal volumetric lighting and a complete absence of biological skin textures, pigments, or orographic markings.
